resources.string: Mirror your main screen to the external/cover display on foldables.
Your main screen is being mirrored to the external display.
Let me choose (one app or entire screen)
Keep capturing when the cover session ends
Reopen the cover when ExtShare is visible again
Shrink to picture-in-picture when leaving ExtShare while mirroring (keeps the cover on)
Experiment: floating button instead of picture-in-picture (needs \"Display over other apps\")

Tap Clear log before each test, then Copy log afterwards and paste it to Claude.

A. Pop-up: Stop, open ExtShare as a pop-up window (Recents → ExtShare icon → Open in pop-up view), tap Start, then use the app behind it.
B. Split screen: same as A, with ExtShare in split screen.
C. Picture-in-picture: turn on "Shrink to picture-in-picture", tap Start, press Home and open another app.
D. One app: pick "Let me choose", tap Start and choose an app in Android's dialog. Combine with A, B or C.
E. Coming back: after the cover goes dark, return to ExtShare. With "Reopen" on, the cover should come back without asking for permission again.
